name: Waabi
sub: Autonomous trucking L4; Simulation & synthetic data
regions: United States; Canada; future Uber platform
leadership: Raquel Urtasun, founder and CEO; Lior Ron, COO
about: AI-first autonomous trucking company built around simulation-heavy development. In 2026 they became strategically important for Uber's robotaxi ambitions as well as Volvo truck autonomy.
model: Autonomous trucking technology licensing; robotaxi partnership with Uber; simulation platform advantage
financing: $1.28B raised, including a $750M Series C (Jan 2026, Khosla and G2-led) and up to $250M in milestone-based investment from Uber
investors: Uber, Khosla, G2VP, Volvo Group, Nvidia
opMaturity: Public pilot with safety driver / pre-driverless commercial
deployment: Dallas-Houston freight with safety drivers; Volvo autonomous truck integration; robotaxi deployment announced with Uber
metrics: Volvo partnership to integrate Waabi Driver into VNL Autonomous trucks
signal: Expanding beyond trucking: January 2026 agreement with Uber to deploy at least 25,000 Waabi-powered robotaxis

sources.title: Autonomous trucking startup Waabi raises $750 million to expand into robotaxis
